name: DC 311 service requests
traps: Measures who calls rather than what is broken — never compare request volume between neighborhoods
notes: Has a usable ZIP field; a good weekly signal

name: MPD crime incident data
traps: Police Service Area boundaries do not match ZIP boundaries — report counts by PSA and disclose the mismatch; figures are preliminary and get reclassified, so published numbers drift for weeks afterward

name: Open Data DC portal
traps: A single citywide portal covers what would be split between city and county elsewhere
notes: Catalog hub for most DC agency datasets
